name: Michelle Randolph
bio:
Michelle Randolph (born September 11, 1997) is an American actress and model who played Elizabeth Strafford in 1923 (2022–25), Ainsley Norris in Landman (2024–present) and Madison in Scream 7.

credits.title: Chasing Nightmares
credits.overview: A college student risks her and her friends' lives to track down the meaning behind the nightmares she has about a girl and a delusional masked man.

credits.title: Clashing Through the Snow
credits.overview: Rival publishing editors Ryan Mitchell and Hannah Hendricks are stranded by a holiday snowstorm and forced to share a rental car to New York, where a career-saving deal awaits them both. As roadside mishaps and small-town detours pile up, the holiday spirit begins to melt their fierce rivalry into something unexpected.

credits.title: Scream 7
credits.overview: When a new Ghostface killer emerges in the quiet town where Sidney Prescott has built a new life, her darkest fears are realized as her daughter becomes the next target. Determined to protect her family, Sidney must face the horrors of her past to put an end to the bloodshed once and for all.

credits.title: The Throwback
credits.overview: A married couple face holiday chaos when an overwhelmed mother suffers a breakdown and reverts to her carefree college-party lifestyle, leaving her bewildered husband to manage the fallout as she teams up with their young neighbour for a wild adventure.

credits.title: The Resort
credits.overview: Four friends head to Hawaii to investigate reports of a haunting at an abandoned resort in hopes of finding the infamous Half-Faced Girl. When they arrive, they soon learn you should be careful what you wish for.

credits.title: 5 Years Apart
credits.overview: Two estranged brothers born on the same day, five years apart, run into each other at their family vacation home with wildly different expectations for how their birthday weekend is going to play out.

credits.title: A Snow White Christmas
credits.overview: When Blanca Snow is faced with spending Christmas with her dastardly stepmother, Victoria, she attempts to fulfill her late father’s wishes and create new memories as a family. credits.title: House of the Witch
credits.overview: A group of high-school kids set out to play a Halloween prank at an abandoned house, but once they enter they become victims of a demonic witch who has set her wrath upon them.
